basic_profile.bio: Basketball enthusiast residing in Toronto, Canada. Passionate about sports management and video game modding. By day, I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company, mostly handling backend systems. I enjoy spending late evenings tinkering with basketball simulation games and creating custom mods. I live with my partner and our two cats. My online activity peaks during late nights and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive experience in software development and game modding, primarily self-taught through online resources and forums. I have a strong background in sports analytics acquired through online courses and personal projects involving basketball simulations.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: strict, with a keen understanding of sitewide and subreddit-specific rules, often guiding others to adhere to them
